verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing line saying it is easy to see performance details for agents, teams and lead sources, which suggests built-in performance reporting. Nothing documents building custom reports or dashboards, or covering pipeline, activity and conversion specifically. The REST API and Smart Lists are building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented custom report and dashboard building, pipeline/activity/conversion metrics, evidence that no spreadsheet export is needed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: With Follow Up Boss it's easy to see performance details for agents, teams and lead sources
